name: 4D Projection Dream Weavers
description: A continuous slice through 4-dimensional fractal space. The mouse smoothly controls two extra dimensions, allowing genuine exploration of higher-dimensional forms. Audio modulates scale, speed, and detail.

params.name: Base Scale
params.description: Overall zoom level in 4D space

params.name: Temporal Speed
params.description: How fast the 4D structure evolves

params.name: Fractal Detail
params.description: Amount of fine detail visible

params.name: 4D Mouse Sensitivity
params.description: How strongly the mouse moves through the extra dimensions

name: Acoustic String Theory
description: Vibrating string harmonics visualized as oscillating sine waves in perspective, with audio-driven pluck and resonance.

name: Volumetric Fog
description: Volumetric fog with ray marching, Mie/Rayleigh scattering, height-based density, god rays, and mouse-controlled light source

name: Geometric Pulse
description: Audio-reactive geometric patterns with kaleidoscope symmetry, shape morphing, neon glow, and frequency band visualization

name: Aurora Borealis Loom
description: Aurora curtains woven like fabric on a celestial loom. Threads of light interlace with weft and warp patterns. Bass swells the weave, mids shift hue through the spectrum, treble adds bead-like ionization nodes. Mouse pulls the fabric.

name: Aurora Curtain
description: Chapman layer auroral excitation with Kelvin-Helmholtz instability and domain-warped curtain folds. Physically inspired colors by altitude via OkLab mixing: red O(1D) high, green O(1S) mid, blue N2+ low. Enhanced with Fresnel rim lighting on folds, temporal feedback trails, two-tone atmospheric key/fill, starfield blackbody temperatures, and audio-reactive chromatic aberration. Mouse drags magnetic zenith; depth drives extinction.

name: Lenia Continuous
description: Continuous cellular automata (Lenia) with smooth growth functions, multiple kernel radii, and biological emergence patterns

name: Bioluminescent Abyss
description: An infinite deep underwater landscape with swaying tube worms and thermal vents, featuring bioluminescence and deep sea atmosphere.

name: Bioluminescent Bloom
description: Deep-ocean bioluminescent colony driven by Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion with chemotaxis and quorum-sensing glow activation. Background tendrils provide ambient light. Audio injects nutrients and triggers stress flashes; mouse drops nutrient pellets. Depth attenuates bioluminescence.

name: Bubble Chamber
description: Simulates subatomic particle trails in a magnetic field using a feedback loop.

name: Chromatic Ghost Tunnel
description: A perspective tunnel of chromatic ghost echoes. Each ring is RGB-split by audio bands. Bass warps tunnel depth, mids add spiral rotation, treble creates stroboscopic ring flashes. Mouse steers tunnel flight.

name: Chrono-Voronoi Mycelium
description: A living fungal network that grows across multiple time scales. Voronoi cells represent fungal colonies; cell edges glow as mycelium hyphae. Different generations coexist as translucent layers. Temporal feedback accumulates growth rings. Bass = nutrient pulse triggers spore bursts and faster spread via golden-ratio seed displacement. Mouse inoculates new colonies. ACES tonemapped with chromatic aberration.

params.name: Growth Bias
params.description: Favors newer vs older growth generations

params.name: Temporal Scale
params.description: How spread out the different time layers are

params.name: Decay Influence
params.description: How strongly older generations fade

params.name: Pattern Complexity
params.description: Controls the density of the smallest mycelium threads

name: Coral Growth
description: Procedural coral and lichen branching structures that grow organically across cells. Audio accelerates growth and adds color vibrancy.

name: Cosmic Jellyfish
description: A majestic, translucent jellyfish floating in a cosmic void, with bioluminescent glow and rhythmic pulsation.

name: Cosmic Web Filament
description: Simulates the large-scale structure of the universe with dark matter filaments and voids. Mouse acts as a gravity well; audio and depth drive intensity and color shifts.

name: Crystalline Fracture
description: Fracture mechanics simulation with stress intensity factor-driven crack propagation, branching, percolation connectivity, and hackle marks on translucent crystal surfaces. Thin-film iridescence and subsurface scattering. Audio loads stress and triggers catastrophic failure; mouse applies point stress. Depth controls crystal thickness perspective.

name: Crystalline Veins
description: Mineral vein patterns growing through dark stone. FBM-based crack and vein generation with gold, copper, and silver chromatic veins. Bass drives vein pulse, mids control growth density, treble adds crystalline sparkles. Mouse attracts vein growth.

name: Deep Sea Thermal Vent
description: Hydrothermal vent on the ocean floor: billowing mineral-rich plumes rise upward, glowing with chemosynthetic life. Bass swells the plumes, mids add particle turbulence, treble creates bioluminescent microbe flashes. Mouse distorts vent flow.

name: Electric Eel Storm
description: Electric eels swimming through a conductive storm cloud, discharging arcs between them. Bass drives eel body pulses, mids create storm cloud turbulence, treble triggers lightning arc flashes. Mouse attracts the eel school.

name: Emergent Calligraphic Weave
description: Sumi-e ink wash simulation with pressure-sensitive Bézier brush strokes, ink viscosity flow, paper absorption capillary action, and dry-brush texture. Audio drives brush speed and splatter; mouse acts as the brush with pressure from click duration. Depth scales paper grain.

params.name: Field Complexity
params.description: How intricate the underlying orientation field is

params.name: Stroke Persistence
params.description: How long strokes remain visible before fading

params.name: Pattern Coherence
params.description: Encourages formation of larger connected structures

params.name: Field Chaos
params.description: Adds turbulence to the orientation field

name: Fire Smoke Volumetric
description: Volumetric fire and smoke simulation with chromatic temperature gradients (R hot to B cool), temporal smoke persistence via dataTextureC, audio-driven turbulence enhancement, physical transmittance, and depth-layered alpha.

name: Fractal Ice Palace
description: Recursive ice crystal palace with fractal branching architecture. Chromatic ice refractions: blue core, cyan edges, white sparkle. Bass shakes the palace, mids control recursion depth visually, treble adds frost glitter. Mouse melts local ice.

params.name: Palace Scale
params.description: Overall size of the ice palace structures

params.name: Recursion Depth
params.description: Fractal recursion depth of ice branching

params.name: Frost Amount
params.description: Amount of frost glitter and ice particles

params.name: Refraction
params.description: Strength of chromatic refraction dispersion

name: 3D Sierpinski Chaos Game
description: Iterated function system rendering a 3D Sierpinski tetrahedron using the chaos game algorithm. Thousands of point samples create intricate cloud-like renders of the fractal solid with depth-based coloring and perspective projection. Mouse rotates the 3D view in real-time.

name: 4D Projection Dream Weavers
description: Smooth continuous slicing and projection through higher-dimensional fractals and lattices. Mouse controls navigation through the extra two dimensions providing genuine higher-dimensional exploration. Audio affects fractal parameters and projection quality. Ethereal mathematical dream-like forms.

name: Abyssal Chrono-Coral
description: A vast abyssal coral reef drifting through gravitational time. Slow geological growth rings expand over eons. Mids and treble drive bioluminescent pulses. Mouse clicks create sediment disturbance events that trigger sudden bloom explosions across the reef. Gravitational lensing bends light around dense coral structures.

name: Abyssal Leviathan-Scales
description: A mesmerizing, infinite expanse of massive, interlocking biomechanical armor scales that undulate like a breathing cosmic leviathan, parting to reveal a blazing, audio-reactive quantum fusion core beneath.

name: Acid Lissajous
description: Reactive neon Lissajous curves that live under your cursor and the music. Mouse gravity bends the strands, click bursts emit shockwaves, bass/mid/treble drive scale/morph/sparkle, video luma spawns extra color, and depth-aware temporal feedback leaves self-advecting acid trails.

name: Alien Flora
description: An infinite procedural forest of bioluminescent alien vegetation with swaying mushrooms and atmospheric fog.

name: Alpha Aurora
description: Procedural aurora borealis with rich spectral band blending, dynamic audio-reactive pulsing, and atmospheric depth. Enhanced color and motion for greater visual impact.

name: Aperiodic Monotile Hat
description: Aperiodic hat tiling (monotile) with animated edge glow and audio-reactive color cycling. Rotates and scales with parameters.

name: Apollonian Gasket
description: Apollonian circle packing fractal rendered via iterative circle inversion. Descartes-based circle configuration with metallic coloring, rainbow chromatic aberration on inversions, and mouse-driven point inversion.

name: Art Deco Skyscraper
description: Infinite vertical ascent up a monumental Art Deco tower with gold fluting and geometric patterns.

name: Astral-Silk Chrono-Weaver Arachnid
description: A majestic, biomechanical celestial arachnid suspended in a deep cosmic void, continuously weaving an intricate, glowing fractal web of 'astral silk' out of raw quantum time-fluid, heavily reacting to bass frequencies by sending shockwaves of light through its geometric threads.

name: Astro-Kinetic Chrono-Orrery
description: A hyper-intricate cosmic mechanism of nested, rotating brass and energy rings orbiting a blazing quantum singularity, merging celestial mechanics with clockwork precision.

name: Astro-Mechanical Quantum-Furnace Engine
description: A towering, slowly rotating cosmic engine composed of interlocking brass-like fractal gears floating in a deep-space nebula, powered by an intensely glowing core of quantum particle systems that spew audio-reactive aether plasma.

name: Audio Spirograph
description: Audio-reactive spirograph with harmonic resonance using epitrochoid and hypotrochoid curves with musical frequency ratios

name: Audiovisual Mandelbulb
description: Raymarched 3D Mandelbulb fractal with video texture mapping, audio-reactive geometry mutation, and depth output.

name: Aurora Borealis Synthesis
description: Render a 3D volume of swirling aurora light and project it onto the 2D video surface, with audio-driven motion and depth-based mapping.

name: Aurora Silk
description: Flowing aurora curtains with silky spectral ribbons, now in HDR with ACES filmic grading, dynamic temperature shifts, split-tone shadows/highlights, Fresnel rim lighting, volumetric god rays, caustic dapples, and depth-layered fog. Reacts to bass, mids, and treble.

name: Auroral Ferrofluid-Monolith
description: A colossal liquid-metal monolith whose surface forms readable magnetic glyphs under strong bass, then collapses into chaotic auroral breakup on treble. Mouse drag rotates an external magnetic field that sculpts the ferrofluid in real time.

name: Barnsley Fern
description: A self-similar fractal fern generated by an iterated function system with 4 affine transformations. Natural forest palette with HDR sunlight filtering through fronds. Audio morphs between fern varieties, mouse attracts frond tips, depth controls leaf detail, and domain warping plus Halton quasi-random sampling add organic motion.

name: Belousov-Zhabotinsky Reaction
description: Chemical oscillator producing spiral waves and target patterns via reaction-diffusion dynamics. Bass modulates reaction rate, mouse seeds new spiral centers, depth controls diffusion.

name: Bifurcation Diagram
description: Logistic map bifurcation diagram visualizing the transition from order to chaos with density-based coloring and Lyapunov exponent highlighting

name: Bio-Luminescent Jelly
description: SDF tentacle jellyfish with pulsing bio-luminescence and glow-intensity alpha encoding. Audio drives pulse rhythm and sparkle particles; mouse attracts the jellyfish and creates shockwaves.

name: Bioelectric Pulse
description: Reaction-diffusion-like organic pulses through a noise-driven substrate. Audio energizes the pulse field, and mouse activation emits a secondary bioelectric wave.

name: Bioluminescent Aether-Jellyfish Swarm
description: A mesmerizing deep-space ocean with translucent aether-jellyfish reacting to audio.

name: Biomechanical Hive
description: An infinite, claustrophobic structure of hexagonal cells blending industrial machinery with organic tissue. Features pulsating lights, rhythmic breathing, and slimy metallic textures.

name: Bioreactor Bloom
description: Reactive cellular colonies pulse and mutate, with toxic blooms around the cursor field.

name: Bismuth Crystal Citadel
description: Endless procedural canyon of iridescent bismuth crystals with physical light transmission. Features metallic Fresnel reflection, thin-film interference, and oxide layer transmission.

name: Brutalist Monument
description: Massive concrete architecture in an atmospheric void.

name: Buddhabrot Aura
description: Upgraded Buddhabrot fractal with proper escaping-orbit trajectory accumulation, importance sampling, orbit-trap iridescence, HDR bloom, ACES tone mapping, and chromatic aberration on high-density regions. Bass drives orbit iteration count, mouse zooms into fractal regions, and depth controls orbit density perspective.

name: Celestial Aether-Seraphim Wings
description: A majestic hyper-dimensional array of fractal wings enriched with aerodynamic lift physics. Angle of attack α from mouse Y drives C_L=2πα (thin airfoil). Stall at ~15° creates turbulent breakdown. Bass drives flapping frequency via damped oscillation. Temporal feedback, chromatic aberration, and ACES tone mapping.

name: Celestial Forge
description: A massive sci-fi megastructure enclosing a miniature star, featuring contra-rotating rings, plasma arcs, and glowing panels.

name: Celestial Nanite-Swarm Nebula
description: A majestic, slowly churning nebula constructed entirely from trillions of glowing, synchronized nanites that dynamically self-assemble into intricate, shifting geometric constellations and colossal architectural megastructures in deep space.

name: Celestial Prism-Orchid
description: A mesmerizing, infinite expanse of refractive, crystalline petals that fold, bloom, and scatter starlight into vivid chromatic spectrums, dynamically responding to cosmic winds and audio vibrations.

name: Celestial Quantum-Glass Dragonfly
description: A hyper-dimensional, biomechanical dragonfly forged from ethereal quantum-glass and liquid starlight, its intricate fractal wings constantly refracting cosmic energy and beating in synchronous rhythm with ambient audio frequencies inside a volumetric plasma storm.

name: Celestial Weave
description: A woven night-sky tapestry of luminous warp and weft threads stitched with star knots.

name: Celestial Yggdrasil-Matrix
description: An infinitely branching, cosmic tree constructed from intertwining ribbons of stellar plasma and quantum circuitry that pulses with the heartbeat of the universe, fusing organic arboreal forms with intricate cosmic geometry.

name: Cellular Automata Tapestry
description: Convert the video feed into a living reaction-diffusion tapestry.

name: Chaos Game IFS
description: Iterated function system chaos game generating fractal attractors. Audio drives iteration depth and attractor scale. Rotating attractor points.

name: Chromatic Acid Drip
description: Liquid LSD-like chromatic dripping with RGB channel separation. Upgraded with universal-indicator pH color science: drips change color as they fall through a realistic acid→base gradient. Mouse creates localized acid/base splashes. Critical-angle refraction, temporal feedback trails, chromatic aberration, and ACES tone mapping.

name: Chromatic Glass Lattice
description: A crystalline, infinite lattice of dispersing glass that refracts background light into separating RGB spectrums, shattered dynamically by sound frequencies.

name: Chromatic Metamorphosis
description: Metaballs morph continuously between sphere, torus, box, and capsule shapes via smooth-min SDF blending. Surface color evolves independently from geometry in flowing waves.

name: Chromatic Singularity-Loom
description: A majestic, gravity-warped cosmic loom weaving fractal strings of pure light around a central singularity.

name: Chromodynamic Plasma-Collider
description: A hyper-speed journey down an infinite magnetic containment tunnel where sub-atomic particles collide and shatter into vibrant, audio-reactive showers of exotic matter.

name: Chrono-Kitsune Prism Weaver
description: A living prismatic kitsune spirit weaving through a chrono-void lattice with deep temporal feedback and audio reactivity.

name: Chrono-Mycelial Tapestry
description: A multi-temporal fungal network where different generations of mycelium coexist in layered time, creating a living, breathing tapestry of organic growth across temporal dimensions.

name: Chrono-Voronoi Mycelium
description: Multi-temporal Voronoi fungal growth system where different generations of mycelium exist as layered temporal states, creating organic networks that evolve across time. Mouse introduces nutrients affecting multiple time layers. Audio controls growth vs decay rates.

name: Chronos Labyrinth
description: An infinite, Escher-esque maze of shifting geometric staircases and corridors suspended over a void, with glowing temporal anomalies.

name: Chronos Monolith Resonator
description: A hyper-dimensional, endlessly shifting obelisk of quantum dark-matter suspended in a cosmic void, projecting glowing ribbons of temporal energy that ripple and distort in sync with unseen gravitational waves.

name: Conway Game of Life
description: Conway's Game of Life cellular automaton rendered with glowing neon cell states on a coarse grid. Rules morph between Classic, Day & Night, and HighLife over time. Bass triggers random cell births, mouse draws live cells, and depth controls grid density. Features temporal persistence for death fade trails and chromatic aberration on state-change events.

name: Coral Reef Colony
description: Upgraded coral reef with space colonization branching, DLA patterns, fBm polyp detail, bioluminescent fluorescent proteins, subsurface scattering, caustic light, HDR bloom, and ACES tone mapping. Bass drives nutrient availability, mids steer current, treble triggers spawning. Mouse attracts growth; depth filters water color.

name: Cosmic-Clockwork Dyson-Sphere
description: A hyper-intricate colossal megastructure of interlocking golden gears, glowing plasma conduits, and rhythmic mechanical fractal shifts enclosing a blinding quantum singularity. Upgraded with enhanced KIFS SDFs, domain-warped FBM, Worley/Voronoi noise, Beer-Lambert volumetric extinction, Fresnel-Schlick metallic reflections, gear-ring toroids, and deep audio reactivity.

name: Cosmic Slime Mold
description: Simulation of slime mold growth with vivid psychedelic coloring. Branching veins of bright neon spread across the screen in organic dendritic patterns. Colors shift from deep purple to hot pink to electric cyan. Mouse feeds the slime causing rapid growth pulses.

name: Cosmic Web Filament
description: Dark matter web with Voronoi filaments, FBM warping, and mouse gravity wells. Hypnotic cosmic structure with purple-to-cyan gradients.

name: Cryogenic Frost-Plasma Matrix
description: An infinitely shattering and reforming matrix of absolute-zero hyper-fractals that bleed iridescent thermal plasma when fractured by heavy bass frequencies.

name: Crystal Caverns
description: Infinite procedural cave system with glowing crystals featuring physical light transmission. Crystals have IOR-based Fresnel reflection and variable purity affecting their glow transparency.

name: Crystal Lattice Growth
description: Mineral dendrites crystallise from a golden-ratio nucleation seed. Radially symmetric branches grow with bass energy, prismatic hue shifts with mids, treble adds refractive sparkle.

name: Crystalline Chrono Dyson
description: A crystalline Dyson sphere with KIFS fractal panel interiors, Worley/Voronoi crystal lattice, Fresnel-Schlick reflections, plasma conduits with Beer-Lambert subsurface scattering, domain-repeated panels, and audio-reactive quasar core. Mouse orbits the structure.

name: Crystalline Mandala Bloom
description: Audio-reactive kaleidoscopic mandala that folds the source image through a rotating polar symmetry. Crystalline petal SDFs, hue-rotated chroma, concentric bass-rings, and treble sparkles bloom outward from a mouse-anchored center.

name: Cyber-Organic Liquid-Neon Pulsar
description: A biomechanical, pulsating celestial core composed of hyper-viscous liquid-neon and crystalline techno-organic fibers. Enriched with Crab Pulsar 30.2 Hz strobe and 10^8 Tesla magnetic field topology.

name: Procedural Cyber Terminal (ASCII)
description: Transforms the input video feed or image into a high-tech, procedural ASCII terminal display using Signed Distance Functions (SDFs).

name: Cybernetic Ferro-Coral
description: A biomechanical reef of magnetic, liquid-metal coral that dynamically shapes itself in response to acoustic vibrations, revealing a glowing quantum-plasma core beneath a dark metallic exterior.

name: Cybernetic Liquid-Chrome Engine
description: A colossal, endlessly shifting mechanical engine constructed of hyper-reflective liquid chrome, pumping iridescent plasma through infinitely complex fractal pistons that react to the heavy bass of audio frequencies.

name: Cybernetic-Mycelium Neural-Web
description: A hyper-organic, glowing network of bio-mechanical mycelial threads that endlessly branch, mutate, and pulse with neon-quantum data streams.

name: Cycloid Bloom
description: Five nested hypotrochoid (Spirograph-style) curves layered into a blooming floral mandala. Each layer uses a different gear ratio that slowly evolves, petal glowing with prismatic hues that respond to audio. Feedback accumulation burns bright arcs.

name: Cymatic Plasma-Mandalas
description: A hyper-intricate, unfolding kaleidoscope of glowing liquid geometry that dances and weaves complex, sacred-geometry-inspired mandalas in direct response to audio frequencies.

name: Cymatic Quantum-Silk Loom
description: A majestic hyper-dimensional loom weaving luminescent quantum silk into cymatic mandalas driven by cosmic audio frequencies, with iridescent neon color shifting.

name: Peter de Jong Attractor
description: Strange attractor density accumulation for the 2D Peter de Jong map: x' = sin(a·y)−cos(b·x), y' = sin(c·x)−cos(d·y). Parameters slowly morph through time, continuously transforming the attractor topology through butterflies, snowflakes, spirographs, and alien lace-work. Temporal Monte Carlo builds density; bass warps the geometry; mouse pans and click-zooms.

name: Depth-Refracted Liquid Stained Glass
description: Polar facet refraction with chromatic edge dispersion per depth edge, temporal caustic flicker, audio-driven refraction strength, and depth-aware bevel normals. Fixed float-modulus bug.

name: DLA Copper Deposition
description: Procedural diffusion-limited aggregation copper dendrite growth. Domain-warped fBm noise simulates random walker deposition with stick probability, producing metallic branching structures with oxidation patina and electrolyte depletion fields.

name: DMT Fractal Zoom
description: An infinite zoom through a fractal landscape with DMT-vision-like visual complexity enriched by Wolfram Alpha Mandelbrot data. Each zoom level reveals new fractal details. Escape radius |z|>2 guarantees divergence. Smooth coloring uses log(log|z|)/log(2). Colors are extremely saturated rainbow gradients that shift as you zoom. Bass drives zoom speed and iteration count. Mouse warps the complex plane as a Julia set constant. Temporal feedback creates trails during zoom.

name: Dragon Curve
description: Heighway dragon curve — a space-filling fractal created by repeatedly folding a strip of paper in half. Rendered as a glowing neon line with iteration-depth coloring from red to violet. Audio drives fold depth, mouse zooms into detail, and depth controls line thickness perspective.

name: Dynamic Tessellation (Ornate Fractal Tiles)
description: Compute a screen-space tile grid and replace each tile with a tiny procedurally rendered fractal. The result is a morphing lattice of fractal mini-universes. Now audio-reactive to bass frequencies with meaningful alpha compositing.

name: Echo Dunes
description: Wind-carved sand ridges with heat mirage distortions and cursor-centered acoustic echo rings.

name: Eldritch-Quantum Fractal-Eye
description: A colossal, hyper-dimensional eye constructed from infinitely folding quantum fractals and liquid plasma.

name: Eldritch Tesseract-Hive Mind
description: An impossible, non-Euclidean hypercube hive populated by swarms of luminescent algorithmic sentinels, constantly unfolding and fracturing into new geometric dimensions driven by quantum noise and acoustic energy.

name: Electric Kaleidoscope Storm
description: Electric lightning bolts radiating from the center in a kaleidoscope symmetry pattern with 6, 8, or 12-fold symmetry. Neon cyan, magenta, and yellow bolts crack and flicker on a deep dark background. Bolts rebranch and reseed each frame for constant motion. Sparks fly randomly. Mouse rotates the kaleidoscope and changes symmetry count.

name: Emergent Calligraphic Ecosystems
description: A system of interacting calligraphic strokes following local orientation rules that spontaneously form complex alien writing systems. Mouse plants seeds or disturbs regions. Audio influences stroke behavior and interaction rules. Enriched with Wolfram Alpha Lotka-Volterra predator-prey dynamics: cyclic population oscillations drive ecosystem color waves where prey = green flora and predators = red-orange fauna.

name: Emergent Script Gardens
description: Interacting ink-like and neon strokes follow golden-ratio phyllotaxis (137.5°) to self-organize into alien symbolic gardens. Bass drives growth iteration count. Mouse interaction plants dense stroke seeds with φ-boosted intensity. Temporal feedback creates organic overgrowth trails. ACES tonemapped with chromatic aberration.

name: Erosion Strata
description: Procedural sedimentary rock layers carved by domain-warped erosion channels, revealing mineral veins, fossil imprints, and weathered edges. Features atmospheric haze, subsurface scattering, and geological era palette cycling.

name: Ethereal Anemone Bloom
description: A pulsating, infinite underwater expanse of translucent, bioluminescent anemone-like structures that gently sway in an invisible current, reaching out to feed on the audio frequencies.

name: Ethereal-Aurora Ghost-Orchid
description: A phantom-like, hyper-dimensional orchid whose transparent, glowing petals are formed entirely from captured aurora borealis, blooming and disintegrating infinitely in a volumetric dark-matter void, driven by acoustic resonance. Enriched with Wolfram Alpha aurora physics: oxygen green (557.7 nm) at lower altitude, red (630.0 nm) at higher altitude, nitrogen blue/purple at base, and bass-driven solar wind particle density.

name: Ethereal Cyber-Aurora Hummingbird-Core
description: A hyper-fast, biomechanical hummingbird woven from liquid auroral plasma and shattered quantum glass, hovering within a massive chrono-distortion flower.

name: Ethereal Cyber-Chrono Void-Whale
description: A colossal, slow-moving biomechanical space leviathan swimming gracefully through a dense volumetric plasma-ocean, whose transparent cyber-skeletal ribs refract and ripple with shifting temporal energy streams.

name: Ethereal Glass-Flora Terrarium
description: A translucent macroscopic greenhouse where impossible glass botanicals bloom with neon nectar flowing through crystalline stems, surrounded by gravity-defying pollen particles.

name: Ethereal Quantum-Hologram Bonsai
description: A serene, hyper-dimensional bonsai tree woven entirely from shimmering quantum hard-light, its branches continuously fracturing and self-assembling in probabilistic super-position.

name: Ethereal Silk Veil
description: Multi-layered translucent silk ribbons flowing in an ethereal wind. Audio drives undulation amplitude; mouse gathers and disturbs the fabric like a hand through cloth. Gold-cream palette with depth-layered parallax and fabric sheen.

name: Evolutionary Cellular Gardens
description: Multi-state cellular automata where the rules themselves slowly evolve based on local conditions and global audio input. Audio drives genetic pressure on the automata. Mouse introduces invasive species or protected zones. Organic coral-like emergent structures that change fundamental behavior over time.

name: Feedback Echo Chamber
description: Temporal feedback echo chamber with mouse gravity wells, click shockwaves, fBM domain warp, depth-aware compositing, and psychedelic palette blending

name: Fourier Epicycles
description: Rotating Fourier epicycle wheels tracing harmonic curves with chromatic separation, metallic rim glow, and temporal trajectory trails. Bass drives rotation speed, mouse reshapes coefficients.

name: Fractal Bioluminescence Spore-Network
description: A hyper-organic, slowly expanding fractal network of glowing bioluminescent spores that mathematically bloom and connect via glowing filaments in response to audio frequencies.

name: Fractal Clockwork
description: Infinite interlocking brass gears rotating in perfect mechanical sync. Steampunk raymarched masterpiece with metallic PBR shading and mouse orbit control.

name: Fractal Ember Lattice
description: Hexagonal crystal lattice glowing like hot embers. Mouse click shatters the lattice into rigid shards that fly outward; release to watch them drift back and reform over ~1.5s. Audio drives glow pulse, lattice breathing, and spark frequency.

name: Fractured Monolith
description: A massive, ancient monolith floating above a dark liquid sea, fractured into segmented pieces that pulse with an inner, ethereal light.

name: Galactic Aether-Crystal Geode-Core
description: A hyper-dimensional, slowly rotating cosmic geode cracked open to reveal a pulsating, audio-reactive core of liquid aether-plasma and infinitely recursive chrono-crystals.

name: Ghost Flame
description: Fluid advection flame simulation with temperature-based alpha translucency. Hot regions are bright and slightly translucent, cool regions fade to transparent. Simplex noise advection with upward velocity and vorticity confinement creates ethereal ghost-fire.

name: Glacial-Aether Quantum-Cavern
description: An infinitely deep, freezing subterranean cavern of quantum ice that glows with auroral aether-plasma, physically cracking and echoing with kaleidoscopic light refractions upon heavy bass impulses.

name: Glass Mosaic Liquid Refraction
description: Stained-glass polygon mosaic with FBM domain-warped Voronoi cells, curl-noise liquid flow, physically-based IOR refraction with Fresnel-Schlick reflections, Beer-Lambert caustic attenuation, and chromatic RGB dispersion driven by audio bands. Mouse warps the mosaic grid.

name: Gravitational Strain Field
description: Orbiting gravity wells warp a procedural star field via RK4 geodesic ray integration. Tidal emission glows where gravitational gradients collide. Upgraded with domain-warped FBM, curl noise, Voronoi nebulae, Beer-Lambert extinction, Fresnel-Schlick lensing, accretion disks, and enhanced audio reactivity.

name: Gravito-Phononic Accretion
description: Multiple audio-driven gravitational centers that accrete and sculpt procedural density fields with gravitational lensing distortion. Different audio bands control different gravitational bodies. Mouse can add temporary mass concentration. Dark cores with swirling filamentary gas. Blackbody temperature colors for accretion disks.

name: Holographic Bismuth-Core Reactor
description: A hyper-dimensional, endlessly unfolding bismuth core reactor, merging metallic stepped-fractals with liquid-holographic interference patterns.

name: Holographic Data Core
description: An infinite journey through a quantum lattice of glowing data nodes and pulsing circuits.

name: Holographic Fracture
description: Iridescent cracked planes with SDF fracture lines and thin-film holographic shards. Audio drives crack glow, and mouse interaction spawns new radial cracks.

name: Holographic Lens-Flare Matrix
description: Generate a matrix of holographic lens flares that follow motion in the video or a synthetic flow field.

name: Holographic Membrane
description: Thin-film interference membrane that undulates with depth-based alpha translucency. Audio drives vibration and iridescence; mouse controls viewing angle for rainbow interference patterns.

name: Holographic Plasma-Geode
description: A hyper-dimensional geode cracked open to reveal a swirling, audio-reactive core of liquid plasma and holographic fractal crystals.

name: Holographic Rainbow Surface
description: A liquid holographic surface with iridescent rainbow colors driven by thin-film interference physics. Prismatic diffraction highlights, spectral color separation based on surface normals, temporal feedback trails, chromatic aberration, and audio-reactive film thickness modulation create a scientifically-grounded chromatic light simulation. Mouse tilts the interference plane.

name: Hopf Fibration Fiber Bundle
description: Hopf fibration visualization from S³ to S². Each screen pixel maps to a point on S² whose fiber is a circle in S³, projected via stereographic projection to 2D. Linked circles colored by base-space coordinate with HDR bloom at crossings.

name: Hyper-Bismuth Clockwork
description: A relentlessly grinding, infinite geometric mechanism built entirely of iridescent, square-stepped bismuth crystals that unfold and interlock like a cosmic clockwork engine.

name: Hyper-Dimensional Bismuth-Matrix
description: An infinite, procedurally growing expanse of hyper-dimensional bismuth crystals forming intricate stair-stepped geometric fractals that shimmer with iridescent interference patterns and warp dynamically to audio frequencies.

name: Hyper-Dimensional Tesseract-Labyrinth
description: A dizzying, gravity-defying maze of glowing hyper-cubes that unfold and rotate through 4D space, creating impossible, Escher-like geometries driven by sound.

name: Hyper Labyrinth
description: A 4D maze visualization with neon aesthetics and evolving geometry. Use mouse to orbit the hyper-structure.

name: Hyper Rainbow Vortex
description: A multi-layered chromatic vortex enriched with Wolfram Rankine fluid dynamics: solid-body rotation inside a bass-reactive core and irrotational flow outside. Angular velocity modulated by mids. Mouse spawns secondary vortices. Full upgraded-rgba stack with ACES tone mapping, temporal feedback, chromatic aberration, and semantic alpha.

name: Hyperbolic Crystal Symbiosis
description: Competing and cooperating crystal growth occurring in hyperbolic (Poincaré disk) geometry. Local curvature influenced by audio and mouse position. Exquisite non-Euclidean tiling patterns with iridescent jewel-like coloring and beautiful symmetry breaking.

name: Hyperbolic Tessellation Engine
description: Non-Euclidean Poincaré-disk tessellation in real-time. Hyperbolic tiles subdivide infinitely toward the boundary disk, colored by recursive depth — M.C. Escher meets fractals.

name: Hyperbolic Tree Fractal
description: Recursive tree fractal rendered in hyperbolic Poincare disk. Branches sway with audio, leaves glow with treble. Möbius-transformed space.

name: Hypnotic Vortex Tunnel
description: An infinite vortex tunnel of nested spinning rings coloured by spectral light. Bass spins the rings faster, treble fires radial arc strobes, mouse shifts the vanishing point.

name: IFS Fractal Flame
description: Iterated Function System fractal flame with probabilistic affine transforms, non-linear variations, and flame palette rendering. Features organic fbm drift, temporal accumulation trails, HDR bloom, chromatic aberration, and audio-reactive morphing.

name: Inverse Mandelbrot Realm
description: Instead of iterating coordinates, we iterate color-space vectors through the Mandelbrot map. Each pixel's RGB becomes a complex number that orbits and escapes, creating alien fractal color fields.

name: Islamic Geometric Star-Rose
description: Procedurally generated Islamic geometric patterns enriched by Wolfram Alpha regular pentagon data. Interior angle 108°, central angle 72°. Diagonal/edge ratio φ≈1.618 determines petal proportions. Features girih-style star and polygon tessellations with pentagram-aware geometry. Bass rotates the tessellation. Mouse morphs between star and rose forms. Temporal feedback and chromatic aberration complete the upgraded-rgba stack.

name: Isometric Cyber-City
description: An infinite procedural isometric city with neon lights and traffic.

name: Kinetic Neo-Brutalist Megastructure
description: An endlessly shifting, gravity-defying neo-brutalist megastructure of colossal floating concrete blocks that grind and interlock, revealing glowing, audio-reactive server cores hidden within.

name: Klein Bottle Walk
description: Parametric walk across a Klein bottle surface with FBM texture, diffuse/specular lighting, and audio-reactive color modulation.

name: Koch Snowflake Storm
description: Recursive Koch snowflake fractals animated with domain-warped fBm turbulence. Ice crystal aesthetic with subsurface scattering, HDR corner bloom, and chromatic dispersion on refracted edges.

name: Kryonic Quantum-Aether Fractal-Core
description: A pulsating, zero-gravity containment field where hyper-frozen fractal geometries endlessly unfold and shatter into luminous aether-plasma shards, reacting aggressively to ambient sonic impulses.

name: Langton's Ant
description: Langton's Ant cellular automaton with three independent ants on a toroidal grid. Cells accumulate heat as they are flipped, producing emergent highway patterns after thousands of steps. Heat-map palette from cool blue through yellow and red to white. Bass accelerates trail accumulation, mouse drops new ants, and depth controls viewport zoom.

name: Lenia 2.0 - Multi-Species
description: Advanced 4-species Lenia with 4 distinct kernels (Ring, Disk, Gaussian, Sharp Cross). Creatures evolve, compete, and merge. Mouse feeds different species. Truly alive.

name: Lichen Reaction-Diffusion
description: Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system simulating lichen growth patterns. Creates organic, slowly evolving patterns including coral lichens, leopard spots, and maze-like structures. Patterns morph across different RD regimes. Mouse deposits additional activator chemical.

name: Lichtenberg Storm
description: Dielectric breakdown fractal patterns with phosphorescent afterglow and storm pulses. Branching discharge trees grow from multiple seed points with HDR bloom, halation glow, and electric palette.

name: Liquid-Crystal Hive-Mind
description: A vast, breathing network of hexagonal bio-synthetic cells containing turbulent, iridescent liquid crystals. Smoothed audio drives hive pulse, turbulence, and shimmer while mouse motion rotates and disrupts the local field.

name: Liquid-Neon Cyber-Metropolis
description: An infinite, gravity-defying cyberpunk cityscape constructed from rivers of hyper-luminescent liquid neon and dark matter concrete, where architectural monoliths dynamically extrude, twist, and warp their geometry to the rhythm of heavy audio frequencies.

name: Liquid Rainbow Glass
description: Simulates looking through liquid rainbow glass - thick translucent layers of flowing color with refraction-like effects. Colors blend and swirl like oil in water but extremely bright and saturated. Chromatic dispersion at edges. Mouse stirs the liquid creating swirling vortices.

name: Live Studio Tab
description: A broadcast studio control room aesthetic with live video preview, audio VU meters, waveform scopes, vector scopes, scanlines, chromatic separation, and a blinking LIVE indicator.

name: Lorenz Attractor Flow
description: Real-time visualization of the Lorenz strange attractor using GPU-accelerated ODE integration. Features chaotic butterfly-wing patterns, mouse perturbation, temporal feedback, chromatic dispersion, and temporal color evolution.

name: Lorenz Attractor
description: Strange attractor density accumulation. Each pixel seeds a short Lorenz trajectory near an equilibrium lobe; Gaussian kernel splatting onto the x-z projection builds the iconic butterfly over many frames of temporal Monte Carlo integration. Bass widens the rho parameter for more chaotic spread; mouse pans the view.

name: Luminescent Chrono-Fluid Astrolabe
description: A hyper-intricate, multi-dimensional astrolabe forged from flowing liquid-gold plasma and hard-light holograms, endlessly spinning and realigning its cosmic rings in perfect synchronization with audio frequencies.

name: Luminescent Cyber-Chrono Void-Turtle
description: A majestic, colossal cybernetic space-turtle slowly navigating a deep-space nebula, its intricate shell constructed of floating geometric chronal-plates that shift and emit liquid luminescent plasma in sync with cosmic frequencies.

name: Luminescent Quantum-Void Anglerfish
description: A colossal, biomechanical deep-space anglerfish prowling through a dark-matter ocean.

name: Luminous Cauldron
description: A radiant alchemical cauldron of bubbling plasma, froth, and glittering treble sparks.

name: Luminous-Fluid Chladni-Resonator
description: A mesmerizing, bioluminescent liquid surface that physically organizes itself into hyper-complex, evolving Chladni resonant figures driven by low-frequency audio interference patterns.

name: Magnetic Dipole Field Lines
description: Procedurally rendered magnetic dipole field lines with charged particle trajectories. Simulates iron filings aligning to field lines with glowing ionized particles tracing the magnetic topology. Mouse moves the dipole position and controls field strength.

name: Magnetic Ferrofluid-Sculpture
description: A hyper-reflective, organic-mechanical mass of magnetic liquid that constantly shifts and forms razor-sharp crystalline spikes, rippling with fluid dynamics and metallic peaks driven by audio frequencies.

name: Magnetic Ferrofluid
description: A pulsating, dark metallic liquid with sharp spikes that respond to an oscillating magnetic field.

name: Magnetic Field Lines
description: Magnetic dipole field visualization with field lines and charged particles following the field, featuring North (blue) and South (red) poles

name: Magnetic Field Warp
description: Charged particles warped by a magnetic field with domain-warped FBM turbulence, curl-noise vortices, and Clifford strange-attractor modulation.

name: Magnetic Kelp
description: Subsea kelp strands sway in synthetic currents while cursor magnetism bends entire bioluminescent forests.

name: Magnetic Storm
description: A dynamic magnetic field storm using divergence-free curl noise to render flowing field lines. The mouse sets the magnetic pole; bass drives flow speed and storm intensity; mids shift field-line color; treble adds sparkle.

name: Mandelbox Explorer
description: 2D cross-section of the 3D Mandelbox fractal with box folding, sphere folding, and orbit-trap coloring. Metallic surface with ambient occlusion, HDR specular highlights, and ACES tone mapping.

name: Metaball Soft Body
description: Organic liquid-metal metaballs with coupled harmonic oscillators, Fresnel reflections, subsurface scattering, and chromatic caustics in merge regions. Bass pulsates radii, mouse attracts centers.

name: Micro-Cosmos
description: A microscopic view of a teeming liquid universe, filled with procedural microorganisms, drifting particles, and organic structures.

name: Minimal Surface Soap Iridescence
description: Parametric minimal surfaces morphing between catenoid and helicoid via Bonnet rotation, now with cinematic HDR lighting: view-dependent thin-film interference, Fresnel rim, roughness-aware specular, subsurface scattering glow, HDR bloom, ACES tone mapping, dynamic color temperature, split-tone shadows/highlights, volumetric fog, and chromatic aberration. Audio-reactive curvature and temporal trails preserve the living soap-film soul.

name: Molten Planetary Core
description: A rocky planet's iron-nickel heart: convection cells churn in slow blackbody glow. Bass erupts mantle plumes, treble cracks the crust in magma seams, mouse tilts the view.

name: Multi-Scale Evolutionary Cellular Gardens
description: A multi-state cellular automata system where growth rules slowly evolve based on local conditions and global audio input. Audio drives genetic pressure on the automata. Mouse introduces invasive species or protected zones. Organic, plant-like emergent structures that change their fundamental behavior over time.

name: Murmuration Phantom
description: Starling murmuration simulation — thousands of dark birds flowing in organic, ever-changing shapes against a twilight sky. The flock morphs between coherent structures driven by a curl noise flow field, with individual birds only visible as subtle silver glints at the edges. Bass drives flock density, mids morph between swarm shapes, treble adds edge glints, and mouse creates predator disturbance.

name: Mycelium Network
description: Growing network patterns resembling fungal mycelium with diffusion-limited aggregation branching and bioluminescent tips

name: Navier-Stokes Ink
description: 2D Navier-Stokes fluid simulation with semi-Lagrangian advection, pressure projection, and ink injection. Bass drives injection rate, mouse injects ink and vortices, depth controls viscosity.

name: Nebula Light-Trail Swarm
description: Photon-like particles race through the scene leaving glowing, fading trails that pulse with audio. Creates a constantly reforming nebula.

name: Nebular Chrono Astrolabe
description: A cosmic nebula astrolabe with concentric FBM-domain-warped rings, volumetric curl-noise clouds, satellite box structures, Fresnel-Schlick reflections, Beer-Lambert attenuation, and audio-reactive gravity wells. Mouse bends spacetime.

name: Neon Acid Geometry
description: Geometric shapes (triangles, hexagons, circles) morphing and melting in psychedelic neon. Upgraded with universal-indicator pH color science: geometry edges glow with realistic acid/base transitions driven by bass oscillation. Critical-angle refraction distortion, temporal feedback trails, chromatic aberration, and ACES tone mapping.

name: Neon Cyber Mandala
description: A slowly rotating mandala made of neon geometric shapes including rings, stars, and polygons. Each ring features a different decorative pattern - dots, radiating lines, zigzags, waves, and diamonds. Bright neon rainbow gradients cycle through colors. Connecting threads pulse with energy. Floating particles orbit the design. Mouse controls rotation speed and zoom into the center. Breathing pulse effect brings the mandala to life. Upgraded with golden ratio φ symmetry, Fibonacci petal counts, golden-angle layer rotation, bass-driven rotation, mouse symmetry warp, ACES tone mapping, temporal feedback, and chromatic aberration.

name: Neon Lotus
description: A blooming neon lotus flower with layered petals unfolding in real-time. Bass swells the bloom, mids shift the chromatic glow, treble adds iridescent shimmer on each petal edge.

name: Neon Neural Network
description: A glowing neon neural network visualization enriched with ReLU activation mathematics. Neurons fire using R(x)=max(0,x) thresholds. Bass drives input layer activation intensity. Mids control synaptic connection strength. Treble adds backpropagation error glow as red halos along edges. Network layers visualized as concentric rings of neurons with pulsing signal paths. Mouse controls a cursor node that lights up nearby connections.

name: Neon-Plasma Biomechanical Hive
description: A hyper-organic, biomechanical labyrinth of pulsing neon circuitry and breathing metallic tissue that spawns luminescent plasma-spores reacting to ambient cosmic frequencies.

name: Neon Snowfall
description: Chromatic snow particles descend in luminous streaks with high-frequency treble twinkle.

name: Neon Tropical Paradise
description: A psychedelic tropical paradise with stylized neon palm trees, aurora sky, glowing flowers, and bioluminescent water enriched with ocean light attenuation physics. Hot pinks, electric blues, neon greens, sunset oranges. Mouse creates ripples in the water and sways the trees. Stars twinkle in a psychedelic sky. Surface waters are bright cyan, deeper layers shift through green-blue into abyssal darkness via scientific wavelength-dependent attenuation.

name: Neural Bioluminescence Matrix
description: A pulsing, infinite organic matrix of glowing synthetic neurons firing quantum light impulses across a void, merging biological growth with cybernetic circuitry.

name: Neural Dust
description: Drifting luminous particle field driven by domain-warped FBM. Audio reactivity controls density and jitter, while mouse gravity attracts nearby dust motes.

name: Neural Fractal
description: Neural network weight visualization style fractals using sigmoid, tanh, and swish activation functions instead of standard z²+c iterations

name: Neural Network Glow
description: Render a glowing neural mesh and drive action-potential pulses with audio, creating a living synapse network that lights up in layers.

name: Neuro-Cosmos
description: A mesmerizing 3D generative visualization of a structure that visually bridges the gap between a biological neural network and the cosmic web of the universe.

name: Neuro-Fluid Plasma-Lotus
description: A majestic, hyper-organic lotus flower suspended in zero-gravity, blooming endlessly with translucent liquid-neon neuro-fluid petals that ripple with bioluminescent plasma in sync with ambient cosmic frequencies.

name: Neuro-Kinetic Bloom
description: A vast, deep-sea garden of biomechanical, neon-veined flora that dynamically uncoils and pulses with quantum energy, its tendrils whipping and synchronizing to the rhythm of sound.

name: Neuro-Kinetic Liquid-Gold Lotus
description: A hyper-organic, slowly unfurling macro-lotus made of liquid-gold geometry that dynamically responds to acoustic impulses, its petals rippling with neuro-kinetic plasma energy.

name: Newton Fractal
description: Newton's-method basins for z^n - 1, now with FBM domain-warped coordinates, multi-root color accumulation, smooth iteration counts, multi-shape orbit traps, SDF smooth-union root halos, and reaction-diffusion boundary accents. Audio drives polynomial degree and halo shimmer; ACES tone mapping and chromatic aberration finish the image.

name: Obsidian Echo-Chamber
description: An infinite, abyssal expanse of highly polished, brutalist obsidian monoliths that react to audio by emitting and reflecting brilliant, luminescent echolocation ripples across their glassy surfaces.

name: Opal Circuit
description: Iridescent opal traces pulse through a synthetic circuitry lattice with glowing via nodes.

name: Percolation Threshold
description: Site percolation on a 2D square lattice near the critical threshold p_c ≈ 0.5927. Iterative connected-component labeling with jewel-tone cluster coloring and HDR spanning-cluster bloom.

name: Phase-Transition Memory Weave
description: A viscous history-dependent field undergoing phase transitions between fluid, crystalline, and chaotic states with strong visual memory of past configurations. Audio controls phase transition thresholds. Mouse locally forces phase changes. Beautiful hysteresis and pattern retention.

name: Photonic Crystal-Brain
description: An infinite, glowing network of hyper-refractive crystal neurons that fire iridescent plasma pulses in sync with audio frequencies, generating volumetric glowing synapses within a dark cosmic void.

name: Phyllotaxis Galaxy Spiral
description: Golden-angle phyllotaxis spiral where each floret is a star in a galaxy. Vogel's formula arranges hundreds of stars with Hubble palette colors, Lin-Shu density waves, 3D perspective projection, and depth-of-field Gaussian rendering.

name: Physarum (Slime Mold) Sacred Geometry
description: A psychedelic organic simulation where millions of microscopic agents feed on video input, leaving vibrant, glowing, fractal trails that pulse with audio.

name: Plasma Mandala
description: A psychedelic plasma mandala with audio-driven radial symmetry, spinning petal folds, and mouse-attracted center. Bass drives spin speed, mids shift hue, treble adds sparkle.

name: Psychedelic Wormhole
description: A wildly colorful tunnel/wormhole effect with swirling rainbow plasma patterns spiraling inward. Bright saturated colors cycling through the full spectrum. Multi-octave fBm noise creates organic flowing patterns. Stars and particles stream past the edges as you travel through the cosmic vortex. Mouse controls tunnel curvature and travel speed. Blackbody peak wavelength drives plasma color transitions.

name: Polar Rainbow Explosion
description: A polar coordinate explosion enriched with Wolfram spherical shock-wave dynamics. Bass triggers radial shock fronts; treble injects high-frequency ripple. Mouse directs the explosion origin. Full upgraded-rgba stack with ACES tone mapping, temporal feedback, chromatic aberration, and semantic alpha.

name: Prism Tide
description: Refractive chroma tides form spectral wavefronts and foam-like interference crests. Enhanced with prism dispersion, animated caustics, Mie scattering haze, OkLab color mixing, split-tone grading, and ACES filmic tone mapping.

name: Prismatic Aether-Loom
description: A hyper-dimensional weaving machine where threads of liquid light are spun into iridescent fabrics of space-time, dynamically reacting to audio frequencies and cosmic winds.

name: Prismatic Bismuth Lattice
description: Endlessly folding hyper-geometric expanse of iridescent bismuth crystals with physical light transmission. Features thin-film interference, metallic Fresnel reflection, and oxide layer transmission.

name: Prismatic Crystal Growth
description: SDF crystal lattice that grows over time with Fresnel reflectance for glass-like translucency. Alpha encodes crystal thickness — thin edges are transparent, thick centers opaque. Audio drives growth rate and crystal rotation.

name: Prismatic Cyber-Auroral Manta-Swarm
description: A majestic, hyper-dimensional ocean of auroral plasma where a synchronized swarm of glowing, cyber-organic manta rays glide and ripple in perfect unison with deep ambient acoustic bass drops.

name: Prismatic Cyber-Chrono Void-Kitsune
description: A hyper-majestic, nine-tailed cybernetic space-fox woven from shattering prismatic quantum glass and glowing liquid-aurora.

name: Prismatic Fractal-Dunes
description: An infinite, shifting desert where the sand grains are micro-prisms, rippling and flowing like liquid glass under cosmic winds and erupting into chromatic geysers of light to the rhythm of sound.

name: Prismatic Ion Cascade
description: Mouse-anchored cascade of prismatic ion streams. Curl-warped angular bands radiate from the cursor with chromatic spectral split, fbm-driven shimmer, and audio-reactive flicker. Bass pulses the radial core, mids drive flow speed, treble adds sparkle.

name: Prismatic Quantum-Fractal Nautilus-Engine
description: A hyper-organic spiraling biomechanical nautilus shell forged from prismatic quantum glass and auroral plasma, endlessly unfurling within a deep-space nebula while reacting explosively to ambient acoustic frequencies.

name: Prismatic Void-Weaver Ouroboros
description: A hyper-dimensional, endlessly twisting serpentine ring forged of chromatic plasma and fractal dark matter.

name: Protocell Division
description: Synthetic biology oil droplets in water that divide and merge like protocells. Rainbow-colored oil slicks on spherical membranes, organic blob shapes deforming under surface tension, and sudden division events where one cell splits into two. Bass triggers division events, mids control surface tension, treble adds membrane vibration ripples, and mouse attracts nearby blobs.

name: Psychedelic Layered Time-Stamps
description: Overlay multiple delayed copies of the video, each with a different color offset and evolving distortion.

name: Psychedelic Moire Flower
description: Hypnotic overlapping concentric patterns creating psychedelic moire interference. Multiple rotating line sets at different speeds produce mesmerizing flower-like shapes with neon hot pink, electric orange, lime, and cyan colors.

name: Psychedelic Time-Warp Kaleidoscope
description: Mirror the image around a dynamic axis with a time-varying mirror count. Reflection vectors are distorted by a 3D noise field for a shimmering kaleidoscope. Now with temporal feedback and chromatic dispersion.

name: Quantum Aether Origami
description: A quantum origami folding surface with 5-fold KIFS fractal iteration, domain-warped fold planes, FBM surface detail, multi-band thin-film interference via Fresnel-Schlick, curl-noise aether flow, and audio-reactive fold deformation. Mouse morphs between flat and folded states.

name: Quantum-Chrome Serpent Ouroboros
description: A hyper-dimensional, endlessly twisting serpentine ring forged of liquid-chrome and fractal dark matter that consumes its own geometric tail while weaving a tapestry of light across the void.

name: Quantum-Entangled Ferrofluid Engine
description: A quantum-mechanically enriched ferrofluid visualization. Wavefunction ψ(x,t) interference patterns drive ferrofluid spike formation. Probability density |ψ|² modulates glow intensity. Bass triggers wavefunction collapse probability. Mouse acts as a quantum measurement device, collapsing superposition and sharpening the interference pattern. Features double-slit interference, entanglement glow, and metallic PBR rendering.

name: Quantum-Fluorescent Aether-Moth Swarm
description: A hyper-dense, glowing swarm of ethereal quantum 'moths' that dynamically flock and self-organize into luminous geometric mandalas, reacting violently to acoustic frequencies.

name: Quantum-Fluorescent Nebula-Anemone
description: A hyper-organic, glowing cosmic sea-anemone suspended in a volumetric deep-space nebula, whose translucent quantum tentacles ripple and mathematically divide in perfect sync with ambient acoustic frequencies.

name: Quantum Foam Alpha
description: Particle positions rendered as quantum probability clouds with uncertainty-based alpha translucency. Audio drives vacuum fluctuations and pair creation; mouse measurement collapses the wavefunction.

name: Quantum Foam
description: Performance-optimized Worley-noise quantum vacuum. A frame-budget-aware Detail slider drives octave count, while blue-noise jitter and a branchless 3x3 Worley kernel keep bubbles smooth and cheap. Bilinear temporal feedback trails previous frames through dataTextureC, and HDR/aux data are chained out via dataTextureA/B for downstream compositing. Bass amplifies bubble density and flash; treble brightens cell borders.

name: Quantum Mycelium
description: A hyper-organic, microscopic journey through an infinitely growing, glowing fungal network that pulses with data-like energy and branches dynamically based on spatial noise.

name: Quantum Pollen
description: Bioluminescent pollen swarms drift through layered, domain-warped fields. Mouse gravity wells pull pollen into orbit, clicks inject explosive bursts, and audio drives scale, morph speed, and sparkle. Incoming video luminance seeds new particles, while motion-vector advection and temporal decay create emergent, living trails.

name: Quantum Singularity-Forge
description: A colossal cosmic forge where swirling accretion disks of superheated stardust collide around a hyper-dense singularity, ejecting crystalline constellations in sync with bass frequencies.

name: Quantum Superposition Lattice
description: Particles exist in quantum superposition — visible at multiple Lissajous-orbit positions simultaneously as Gaussian probability clouds. Mouse clicks collapse the wave function locally.

name: Quasicrystal
description: Penrose tiling-inspired quasicrystal patterns with n-fold symmetry using the projection method from higher-dimensional lattices. Upgraded with domain-warped FBM, Voronoi/Worley noise, Fresnel-Schlick gem surfaces, enhanced harmonics, and deep audio reactivity.

name: Radiant Chrono-Glass Nautilus
description: A hyper-organic, infinitely spiraling nautilus shell forged from refractive chrono-glass and glowing liquid-plasma.

name: Radiant Cyber-Chrono Void-Stag
description: A majestic cybernetic space-stag leaping through a volumetric deep-space nebula, with bioluminescent cyber-antlers forging crystalline pathways of temporal energy.

name: Radiant Quantum-Crystalline Forge
description: A majestic, zero-gravity forge where infinite quantum crystals self-assemble into intricate fractal geometries, pulsating with radiant chromatic energy and refracting light in a dazzling abyssal void.

name: Radiant Quantum-Plasma Kraken-Core
description: A majestic, hyper-organic deep-space kraken composed of swirling quantum-plasma tentacles and a blinding radiant core that pulsates violently in sync with cosmic bass drops.

name: Rainbow Firefly Dance
description: Hundreds of glowing firefly-like particles dancing in organic swirling patterns. Each firefly has a unique rainbow color that cycles over time. Bright neon glow halos around each particle. Mouse attracts the swarm. Fireflies leave brief phosphorescent trails.

name: Raptor Mini
description: Fast predatory mini raptor agents chase the mouse and strike with claws. Audio rage mode boosts speed and attacks.

name: Recursive Ancestral Terrains
description: Fractal landscape generator where terrain features carry genetic parameters from parent generations. The mouse position locally selects which ancestral lineage is expressed, creating alien mountain ranges with evolutionary history. Audio controls mutation rate and generational blending. Upgraded with golden ratio φ persistence, fractal dimension roughness control (Koch D=1.2619 to Sierpinski D=1.585), bass-driven erosion, mouse river carving, temporal sediment layers, ACES tone mapping, and chromatic aberration.

name: Resonant Crystal-Canyons
description: An infinite, procedural canyon constructed entirely from highly refractive, glowing crystals where sound waves manifest as visible ripples of chromatic dispersion, flowing like rivers of light through the jagged terrain.

name: Resonant Quantum-Obsidian Scarab-Engine
description: A hyper-organic biomechanical engine constructed from sleek, interlocking plates of liquid obsidian and glowing quantum circuitry that functions like a colossal scarab breathing and reacting to acoustic energy.

name: Resonant Quantum-Plasma Dragon-Eye
description: A hyper-dimensional, endlessly morphing cosmic dragon's eye forged from swirling quantum plasma and fractal dark matter, its pupil dilating and glowing violently in response to deep acoustic bass frequencies.

name: RGB Diffraction
description: Simulates a multi-slit diffraction grating where separate red, green, and blue wavelengths produce offset interference fringe patterns. Six-fold rotational symmetry creates a spectral starburst. Slit orientation and frequency pulse to audio for reactive prism effects.

name: Sentient Aether-Flora Biosphere
description: A hyper-organic, bioluminescent extraterrestrial terrarium where fractal aether-spores drift and blossom into complex, sentient crystalline flora that pulse with cosmic energy in sync with ambient audio.

name: Sentient Ferro-Silicate Swarm
description: A hyper-dynamic, liquid-metal particle swarm that self-assembles into brutalist geometric architectures before dissolving back into a chaotic, churning ferro-fluid storm.

name: Sentient Liquid-Neon Fractal-Heart
description: A hyper-organic, pulsating biomechanical heart composed entirely of intertwined, liquid-neon fractal arteries that endlessly fold inward upon themselves, beating in perfect sync with ambient cosmic acoustic frequencies.

name: Sentient Quantum-Chrono Leviathan-Moth
description: A majestic, colossal cybernetic space moth floating through a deep-space nebula, its wings woven from crystalline threads of frozen time and quantum aether-plasma that softly pulse and ripple in sync with ambient cosmic acoustics.

name: Crystalline Pulse
description: Geometric crystal formations based on diamond cubic Bravais lattice structure with phonon pulse propagation. FCC lattice positions, acoustic phonon frequency ω = 2√(k/m)|sin(ka/2)|, bass-driven vibration, temporal feedback trails, chromatic aberration, and mouse lattice defect injection create a scientifically-grounded crystallographic visualization.

name: Kinetic Bloom
description: Geometric flower mandala with damped harmonic oscillator physics. Each petal is a spring-mass system: ζ from mids, ω₀ from bass, underdamped motion x(t)=e^(-ζω₀t)cos(ωt). Bloom cycles triggered by bass. Temporal feedback, chromatic aberration, and ACES tone mapping.

name: Nebula Core
description: Deep-space nebula with organic plasma clouds enriched by Wolfram Alpha Hydrogen Balmer Series astrophysics data. H-alpha dominates core, H-beta fills mid regions. Bass drives ionization front expansion. Mouse seeds new star formation.

name: Sierpinski Tetrahedron
description: 3D Sierpinski tetrahedron rendered as a 2D projection with multi-orbit trap coloring (vertex, edge, shell). Domain-warped FBM distorts the view, jewel-tone palette with metallic sheen, HDR specular highlights, and audio-reactive recursion depth.

name: Silica Tsunami
description: A slow-motion wave of refractive glass-like particles that crests and shatters, dynamically reshaping around the mouse and reacting to audio amplitude.

name: Singularity Forge
description: A hyper-dense, gravity-warped crucible of collapsing stars and chaotic plasma rings, endlessly generating and consuming geometric artifacts.

name: Solar Wind Ribbons
description: Magnetised plasma ribbons stream like coronal mass ejections caught mid-flight. Bass swells ribbon width, treble brightens edges, mouse steers the aurora curtain.

name: Sonic Lava Flow
description: Navier-Stokes-style fluid solver with domain-warped FBM, Voronoi crust detail, Beer-Lambert volumetric glow, Fresnel molten surface, enhanced curl noise, and deep audio reactivity creating a living molten world.

name: Sonoluminescent Chrono-Geode Matrix
description: A colossal, infinitely shattering crystalline geode that fractures to reveal a violently erupting sonoluminescent plasma core.

name: Spectral Ferrofluid
description: Magnetic ferrofluid simulation with field-strength alpha translucency and audio-reactive spikes. Mouse acts as a magnetic source while temporal feedback creates organic fluid memory.

name: Stable Fluids (Jos Stam)
description: Classic stable fluids solver with pressure projection. Velocity advection, force application, divergence estimation, Jacobi pressure solve, gradient subtraction, dye advection, and audio-reactive color mapping.

name: Stardust Nebula
description: A stellar nursery in HII emission colours: curl-noise gas clouds, dark absorption pillars, and proto-star sparkle. Bass swells the pillars of creation, treble ignites new suns.

name: Stellar Plasma-Ouroboros
description: An infinite, self-consuming mechanical serpent made of fractured glass scales and stellar plasma.

name: Stellar Web-Loom
description: A hyper-dimensional cosmic loom weaving infinite tendrils of starlight and plasma silk across a dark void, blending organic neuro-network vibes with vast, mechanical astrophysics.

name: Strange Field Flow
description: A strange-attractor flow field blending Peter de Jong and Clifford attractor maps. Each pixel evaluates iterated orbit density and paints acid-neon whorls. Attractor coefficients pulse to bass and treble, morphing the topology. Temporal persistence burns psychedelic trails.

name: String Theory
description: Vibrating string visualizations with interference patterns and harmonics based on the 1D wave equation

name: Superfluid Quantum-Foam
description: A mesmerizing, hyper-turbulent ocean of boiling quantum probability foam, where iridescent hyper-bubbles merge and burst in sync with audio frequencies, releasing flashes of raw cosmic energy.

name: Supernova Remnant
description: Expanding shell structures with shockwave physics and Rayleigh-Taylor instability patterns, inspired by Hubble nebula images

name: Symbiotic Chrono-Mycelium Engine
description: A hyper-organic, ever-evolving cybernetic mycelial network that metabolizes temporal energy, pulsing with luminescent plasma as it entwines around a central quantum gear.

name: Symbiotic Light Networks
description: A network of light-conducting organic structures that grow, compete, and support each other while transporting and transforming light in complex ways. Audio influences light color, intensity, and transmission rules. Mouse seeds or prunes the network. Bioluminescent organic networks with complex internal light transport.

name: Symbiotic Plasma-Reef Matrix
description: A hyper-vibrant deep-sea reef of fractal coral structures and bioluminescent plasma that pulsates with rhythmic audio, swarming with microscopic glowing entities.

name: Tectonic Plasma-Crucible
description: A violently shifting landscape of cooling obsidian geometric slabs floating on a turbulent, audio-reactive ocean of blinding-hot plasma magma that constantly fractures, erupts, and reshapes itself.

name: Temporal Motion Smear
description: Motion-aware temporal smearing using frame differencing and directional blur, creating colorful trails that follow moving objects

name: Thermal Rainbow Topography
description: Topographic terrain visualization with thermal imaging color grading. Contour lines with neon glow trace evolving mountainous terrain rendered in a bright rainbow thermal palette from black through blue, cyan, green, yellow, red to white. Mouse creates glowing hot spots on the landscape.

name: Topological Acoustic Knots

name: Topological Phase Weave
